project.title: NASA Psyche Mission: AR/WebXR for Public Engagement—CERNN: Satellite Experience

section-description.title: Project Overview
section-description.description: This project envisions an accessible, interactive AR experience that translates complex NASA data into an engaging narrative, allowing users of all ages to explore the Psyche spacecraft and track its journey in real time.

item.detail: Users interact with a glowing 3D model, discovering how onboard instruments support the mission's goal of mapping and analyzing Psyche 16.
A scrubbable, real-time tracking system highlights critical milestones from launch to orbit, building anticipation through countdowns and progress markers.
Intuitive mobile gestures ensure audiences of all technical and physical abilities can seamlessly engage with the scientific content.

section-description.title: Core Functional Requirements
section-description.description: Requirements elicit from sponsor for the Psyche mission education project

item.detail: Web-based AR/VR launches instantly via QR code from the Psyche Launchpad without requiring app downloads or personal data.
Bite-sized, single-user educational modules designed for the public, featuring on-demand contextual gesture instructions.
Features a real-time countdown to arrival and an explorable 3D spacecraft model tracking the journey to Psyche 16.
Interactive 3D inspection that uses visual cues (pulsing highlights) to guide users through discovering and learning about onboard instruments.
Navigable milestone tracker allowing users to explore critical mission events, from launch through future instrument deployments.

section-description.title: Sprint Objectives & Execution
section-description.description: Spearheaded early-stage product discovery by synthesizing NASA scientific research, evaluating Augmented Reality (AR) technology stacks, and engineering comprehensive UX prototypes to define requirements for three distinct interactive experiences.

item.detail: Evaluated multiple Augmented Reality (AR) APIs, frontend frameworks, and rendering libraries, documenting comprehensive cost-benefit analyses to dictate the project's core technology stack.
Architected high-level system workflows by developing detailed Use Case diagrams for the "Satellite," "Lore," and "Detective" modules to establish clear user interaction pathways.
Synthesized complex scientific data by analyzing extensive NASA research publications, distilling the findings into concise information sheets to ensure narrative and technical accuracy.
Authored foundational Design Documents and formal Experience Requirements across all planned applications to align stakeholder vision with concrete development milestones.
Designed high-fidelity wireframes and accessible UI mockups for central landing pages and immersive AR interfaces, focusing on user engagement and intuitive navigation.
Modeled preliminary 3D assets of the Psyche asteroid to integrate directly into early visual prototypes and formal stakeholder design presentations.

section-description.title: Inclusive Design & Accessibility
section-description.description: Driven by the mandate to make the Psyche Satellite experience universally accessible, I designed and implemented a suite of user-controlled visual enhancements.

item.detail: Designed custom UI themes to ensure strict legibility standards and support users with visual impairments.
Integrated adaptable color schemes to reduce eye strain and accommodate diverse viewing environments.
Prototyped and developed an intuitive settings menu, empowering users to seamlessly tailor their AR experience to their needs.

stage.title: Sprint 3: Components Page and Mission Timeline Page

section-description.title: Live Mission Tracking & API Integration
section-description.description: To bring the Psyche mission to life, I architected a data-driven experience that translates complex spacecraft telemetry into accessible, real-time mission progress on the homepage.

item.detail: Engineered a pipeline to extract and parse live Ephemeris data from the Horizons API, translating raw orbital telemetry into precise distance figures.
Generated a structured, localized XML database to manage and serve satellite distance data efficiently to the frontend interface.
Developed dynamic UI components to consume the XML data, allowing users to seamlessly track the satellite's journey and explore distinct mission phases.

stage.title: Sprint 4: About Page, Additional Accessibility Features, User Feedback, and Mobile Features

section-description.title: AR Accessibility & 3D UI Enhancements
section-description.description: To make the 3D experience inclusive and visually immersive, I implemented system-wide accessibility themes and refined the 3D environmental UI components.

item.detail: Engineered dynamic theming architecture to apply high-contrast, light, and color-blind accessible themes across all interactive AR pop-ups and buttons.
Ensured user accessibility settings translated seamlessly across the entire application, dynamically adapting interface components to meet specific user needs.
Enhanced the visual cohesion of the virtual space by upgrading the Skybox floor, bridging the gap between functional UI and an immersive 3D aesthetic.

section-description.title: Educational UX Design & Data Architecture
section-description.description: To ensure the experience was highly educational and intuitive for users of all ages and cognitive abilities, I overhauled the content strategy, integrated multimedia elements, and optimized the backend data delivery.

item.detail: Restructured complex technical data for the Mission and Instruments sections into an accessible "What, Why, and How" framework to maximize user comprehension across diverse age groups.
Enriched the educational phases with contextual images and videos, supporting visual learners and increasing overall user retention and engagement.
Re-engineered content delivery by transitioning hardcoded phase data into a structured JSON architecture, improving system scalability and maintaining consistency across the application.
Refined user flows and interface components to guarantee a polished, highly accessible, and confident user experience for all audiences.
